texts.preamble: Murugan vs The Commissioner on 4 March, 2025 Author: V.Bhavani Subbaroyan Bench: V.Bhavani Subbaroyan W In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 04.03.2025 Coram: The Honourable Mrs.JUSTICE V.Bhavani Subbaroyan W.P.No.32296 of 2023 Murugan .. Vs. 1.The Commissioner Food safety and Drug Administration Department , 359, Anna Salai, Teynampet, D.M.S. Campus,Chennai. 2.The Director, Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine. 359, Anna Saalai, Teynampet, D.M.S. Campus, Chennai. 3.The Deputy Director of Health Services, Coimbatore, Race Course Scheme Road, Coimbatore 641018. 4.The Block Medical Officer, Government Primary Health Center, Periyapodhu, Coimbatore District.
texts.facts: ( i ) The petitioner, after completion of the selection process, was declared and selected to the post of the Health Inspector GR.II on 23.10.2007 and joined the service at Government Primary Health Centre, Kedar, Villupuram. Thereafter, the 1st Respondent by invoking power conferred under Section 37 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, deputed the petitioner as Food Safety Officer vide his proceedings in R.No.80849/FSSA/2011/S2 dated 20.09.2011. The petitioner's name was also included in the list at serial no. 365 and the petitioner has been posted as Food Safety Officer for the area of Thiruvennainallur, Villupuram District. ( Uploaded on: 08/04/2025 03:27:52 pm ) service without any blemish. The petitioner was performing his job as a Food Safety Officer without any room for any allegations. While so, the 1st Respondent by his proceedings in R.No. 11268/2017/S1/FSSA dated 30.05.2019 relieved the petitioner to the parent department of the Public Health and Preventive Medicine and directed the petitioner to handover the charges of the post of Food Safety Officer as per the instruction of the Designated Officer. Pursuant to the same, the petitioner relieved from the post of Food Safety Officer and joined in the said parent Department at Cuddalore and at present, working as a Health Inspector Grade-1 at Government Primary Heath Center, Sethumadai, Periyapodhu Block, Coimbatore District. (ii) In the meanwhile, the petitioner was promoted as a Health Inspector Grade 1 in the year 2015. Further, the petitioner had undergone a special course and training in Food Inspection and Sampling Work, which was conducted by the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine and State Food (Health) Authority. The petitioner has also undergone a special training for Food Safety Officer, which was conducted by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India at Chennai. Since during the Murugan vs The Commissioner on 4 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80089282/ 2 tenure of the Food Safety Officer, the petitioner has promptly performed his job with full satisfaction, the petitioner requested the 1st Respondent to post the petitioner as a Food Safety Officer and https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/04/2025 03:27:52 pm ) the petitioner also sent a representation to the 1st Respondent on 31.08.2020 and another representation on 16.07.2021. The same was duly served. Though there are lot of vacancies in Food Safety Department, the petitioner has not been considered, hence this petition. It is to be noted that due to urgent implementation of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, a separate new department had been formed, namely, the Food Safety and Drug Administration Department. The food inspectors, who were worked in various departments have been drawn to this new department on deputation basis and temporarily appointed as Food Safety Officer in the newly created department. The petitioner was also appointed as food safety officer on deputation basis, so far, 210 food safety officers have been repatriated to their parent department based on their poor performance and their willingness. The petitioner was also repatriated to his parent department due to his poor performance by the proceedings in R.No.11268/2017/S1/FSSA dated 30.05.2019 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/04/2025 03:27:52 pm ) and the petitioner joined the duty in his parent department, immediately.
texts.arguments: 3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has undergone a special course and training in food inspection and sampling work, which was conducted by the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine and State Food (Health) Authority. Therefore, the petitioner requested the 1st respondent to post him as a food safety officer vide representation dated 31.08.2020 and another representation dated 16.07.2021, the same was not considered, hence this petition. 4. Per contra, the learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents would submit that the petitioner had been relieved to his parent department of Director of Public Health Department and he was successfully joined in the respective parent department and getting salary till date. The service rules for the food safety officers had been framed in G.O.Ms.No.438, Health and Family Welfare (M1) Department dated 24.09.2018 in Food Safety Department, as per the service rules, the food safety officers appointment have to be filled up only on direct recruitment, therefore, the process of recruitment for the vacant https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/04/2025 03:27:52 pm ) post of food safety officer had been given to the Medical Services Recruitment Board, now the recruitment process is almost over to the 131 vacancy posts of food safety officers. Due to several litigations pending before this court in respect of recruitment, the appointment of newly recruited food safety officers is getting delayed, hence the petitioner cannot be reverted back to food safety department and it is contrary to the act and service rules, thereby pleaded to dismiss the petition.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has undergone a special course and training in food inspection and sampling work, which was conducted by the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine and State Food (Health) Authority. Therefore, the petitioner requested the 1st respondent to post him as a food safety officer vide representation dated 31.08.2020 and another representation dated 16.07.2021, the same was not considered, hence this petition. 4. Per contra, the learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents would submit that the petitioner had been relieved to his parent department of Director of Public Health Department and he was successfully joined in the respective parent department and getting salary till date. The service rules for the food safety officers had been framed in G.O.Ms.No.438, Health and Family Welfare (M1) Department dated 24.09.2018 in Food Safety Department, as per the service rules, the food safety officers appointment have to be filled up only on direct recruitment, therefore, the process of recruitment for the vacant https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/04/2025 03:27:52 pm ) post of food safety officer had been given to the Medical Services Recruitment Board, now the recruitment process is almost over to the 131 vacancy posts of food safety officers. Due to several litigations pending before this court in respect of recruitment, the appointment of newly recruited food safety officers is getting delayed, hence the petitioner cannot be reverted back to food safety department and it is contrary to the act and service rules, thereby pleaded to dismiss the petition.
